title: fix(app-shell): packaged automation does not show "On" for a flow the engine left unarmed (objectui#13159)
body:
Fixes #13159
Clause-②: yes

Setup › Packaged automation drew the activation FLAG as if it were the EFFECTIVE state: every packaged schedule flow the boot reports "NOT bound — disabled by deployment policy" showed a checked switch and an "On" badge, and only the small Details chip said otherwise. The Activation cell now keeps the two facts apart.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/packagedFlows.ts` — the page's reading-rules module (split out of the page file for testability). `joinPackagedFlows` now carries the runtime row's `unboundCause` (only as a non-empty string, absent otherwise, the way `reason` is carried). New pure function `activationReading(row)` returns `off` (flag off), `not-running` (flag on and the engine sent an `unboundCause`), or `on`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` — the badge beside the switch follows `activationReading`: "On" (default variant), "Not running here" (outline variant, never destructive: a deployment policy is not a defect), "Off" (secondary). The switch is untouched: it still shows and writes the flag, so an author can keep the flag set for a deployment that does arm the flow. After a successful toggle the flows half re-reads `GET /automation/_status` (a flows-only counter, so the actions section is not reloaded): the toggle's answer is `{ name, enabled }` only, and the flip can change what the engine armed (switching a schedule flow on under the policy leaves it unarmed; enabling a subflow re-arms its callers through `rejudgeSubflowCallers`). A refused toggle does not re-read.
- New i18n key `packagedAutomation.notRunning` in all ten packs. English "Not running here" and Chinese "未在此运行" are the words Studio's Automations rail already uses for the same state (`engine.studio.auto.notRunning`), so one state reads one way across Setup and Studio. This widens `@object-ui/i18n`'s `TranslationKeys`, so the claim's `Clause-②: yes` stands.
- `.changeset/13159-automation-effective-state.md` — `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

The Details chip, its sentence and its no-classification rule are unchanged; its doc comment is updated because the structured field it waited for now rides the wire. No cause is named anywhere on the page: `unboundCause` is read for PRESENCE only.

## Premise check, measured against objectstack pin `f4755a68a797`

- **H1 (source of the truth): holds.** At the pin, `FlowRuntimeState` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts` declares `unboundCause?: FlowUnboundCause` ("Present exactly on the rows that carry `reason`"), and the engine's `getFlowRuntimeStates` spreads `{ reason, unboundCause }` together from `describeUnboundReason`, which answers for an enabled, trigger-declaring flow that is not bound and returns undefined otherwise. The `_status` route passes those rows through as `{ flows, total }`. Ancestry of the objectstack#23842 implementation (PR objectstack#23854, merge commit `6422da58e83a`) under the pin: local `git merge-base --is-ancestor` answered exit 1, a false negative, because the local objectstack checkout is shallow (13 commits of history under the pin). The REST compare reads both ways: `6422da58...f4755a68` answers `ahead`, ahead_by 321, behind_by 0; the reverse answers `behind`, behind_by 321. So the field is served at the pin and the card is not pin-blocked.
- **H2 (two facts apart): holds**, implemented as above. The switch stays live and checked for an unarmed row.
- **H3 (controls): pinned.** A bound flow reads "On", a flow with no trigger (`bound: false`, no cause) reads "On", a switched-off flow reads "Off", and clicking the switch on an unarmed row still sends `{ enabled: false }`.
- **H4 (acceptance with ablation): see below.**

## Tests

New, in `PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` (describe "the Activation cell says whether the flow runs"): the acceptance case, the controls, every cause read the same way and none styled as an error, the flag still written from an unarmed row, the post-toggle re-read, and no re-read after a refused toggle. New in `packagedFlows.test.ts`: `unboundCause` carried as a non-empty string and absent otherwise, and `activationReading` for each cause, on, and off.

Run at `d126afb`, through the shared verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ packages/i18n/` gave `Test Files 89 passed (89)`, `Tests 1395 passed | 13 skipped (1408)`.

**Ablation, at `d126afb`.** The fix was committed first. The two source files (`PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`, `packagedFlows.ts`) were checked out from the base `4c36eab`; an on-disk count confirmed the mutation landed (`packagedAutomation.notRunning` in the page 1 → 0, `export function activationReading` 1 → 0). The page test file then gave `Tests 4 failed | 17 passed (21)`. Red: the acceptance case ("Unable to find an element with the text: Not running here"), the controls case and the every-cause case (`expected 'On' to be 'Not running here'`), and the post-toggle re-read (`expected 'On' to be 'Not running here'`). Green by design: "still writes the flag" and "no re-read after a refused toggle", which guard behaviour the fix must keep. The restore used `git checkout HEAD --` under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap. It was proven by blob hash equal to HEAD for both files and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Gates (local, at `d126afb`; exit codes captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` → 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` → 0. The dependency closure was built first with `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2` (28/28 tasks).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` → 0 (0 errors, no warning on a changed file); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n lint` → 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → 0 (0 new citations); `pnpm check:control-bytes` → 0; `pnpm check:changeset-claims` → 0; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → 0; `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` → 0; `pnpm check:i18n-keys` → 0; `pnpm check:i18n-drift` → 0 (1 key added, 0 en values changed); `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` → 0 (the new key is not listed); `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` → 0; `pnpm check:spec-symbols` → 0; `pnpm check:test-path-roots` → 0.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues`. It answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it weighs `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, which needs a console build), so the result is left to CI. The packs grew by one short key each.
- Repo-wide runs (full `pnpm test` shards, `Build & E2E`, docs) are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim names the page file. The row model and the join live in `packagedFlows.ts`, the page's own reading-rules module that was split out of the page file "because these are not components". Both it and its test are edited here. No other module is touched: `PackagedActionsSection.tsx` is untouched because packaged actions have no armed-or-not state beside their flag.
- **Two derivations of one fact.** Studio's `deriveFlowRunStatus` derives "not running" from `bound` and `triggerType`. This page reads the contract's classifier `unboundCause`, the field objectstack#23842 added for exactly this page. At the pin the two agree by construction: `unboundCause` is present iff the row is enabled, unbound and declares a trigger. Not a defect, and no card is filed.
- **ADR-0126 §7.4 reading.** §7.4 scopes the page to "on/off for this scope". The switch remains exactly that. The badge's "Not running here" is the same class of exception as the platform `reason` disclosure that objectui#9217 already admitted, because it is sourced from the engine, never inferred client-side.
- A toggle-on can show "On" for one round trip before the re-read lands "Not running here". The switch is disabled only while the toggle request itself is in flight.
- The dispatch named `origin/main` `91b658a`. By worktree creation it had moved, and the branch is cut from `4c36eab`.
- No browser pass was run: the defect and its controls are pinned at the renderer with the fake server, and the ablation shows the acceptance case going red.
